title: Psalm emits this issue when a function is too complicated.
summary: Complicated functions should be split up. Psalm reports it at each error level.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a method is too complicated.
summary: Complicated methods should be split up. Psalm reports it at each error level.

title: Emitted for non-fatal configuration issues, e.g. deprecated configuration switches.
summary: Psalm reports it at each error level.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a by-ref variable is set in two different branches of an if to different types.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 8.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a trait declares a constant in PHP <8.2.0.
summary: Psalm reports it at each error level.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a constructor parameter differs from a parent constructor parameter, or if there are fewer parameters than the parent constructor AND where the parent class has a @psalm-consistent-constructor annotation.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 6 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when encountering a continue statement outside a loop context.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 8.
